journey.metaDescription: How learning works at The Bridge Institute: practical exercises, participation, assignments and workplace preparation.
journey.title: Learning Journey
journey.intro: Learning at The Bridge Institute is practical and participatory. These stages describe how learners grow; they complement the four-year professional development roadmap and are not a fixed schedule.

stages.title: Building foundational knowledge
stages.body: Strengthen core knowledge in thinking, language, numbers, digital skills and programming.

stages.title: Practical exercises and assignments
stages.body: Learn by doing through exercises, assignments and active participation rather than rote memorization.

stages.title: Critical thinking, communication and teamwork
stages.body: Question, reason, communicate clearly and collaborate with peers.

stages.title: Strengthening professional competencies
stages.body: Develop the workplace habits and competencies employers value.

stages.title: Exploring certifications and practical opportunities
stages.body: Explore relevant certifications and practical opportunities when they are available and appropriate.

stages.title: Continuing development
stages.body: Keep growing through reskilling and upskilling throughout professional life.

about.metaDescription: About The Bridge Institute under the University of Integrated Thought (UIT).
about.title: About The Bridge Institute
about.intro: The Bridge Institute, under the University of Integrated Thought (UIT), offers foundational learning and professional development to bridge the gap between education and employment.
about.mission: To bridge the gap between education and employment by preparing graduates to meet the evolving needs of industry.
about.vision: Independent thinkers, effective communicators and capable learners equipped with the foundational skills needed for further education and the modern workplace.
about.philosophy: Moving beyond traditional rote memorization, our courses emphasize practical learning, active participation, and problem-solving.
about.approach: Learners develop essential skills in critical questioning, logical reasoning, communication, teamwork, peer collaboration, and problem identification.
about.alignment: We welcome partnerships with industries, companies, and organizations to develop a workforce equipped with the practical skills and professional competencies employers value.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
This policy explains how The Bridge Institute handles personal information submitted through this website.

## Information we collect
We collect the information you provide in application, contact, partnership and alumni forms, and account details when you sign in. We do not ask for identity documents through this website.

## How we use it
We use your information only to process applications, respond to inquiries, manage learning records and, where you consent, to show an alumni profile publicly.

## Alumni profiles
Alumni profiles are private by default. A profile is only published after you give explicit consent and staff approve it. You can withdraw consent at any time from your alumni dashboard and the profile is hidden immediately. Contact details are never shown publicly.

## Security
Passwords are stored only as secure hashes, access to records is restricted by role, and sensitive changes are logged.

## Your choices
To access, correct or delete your information, contact us using the details on the Contact page.

This policy may be updated by the institute. The current version is always available on this page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.body:
By using this website you agree to these terms.

## Use of the website
Use the website lawfully and provide accurate information in forms. Do not attempt to access accounts or records that are not yours.

## No guarantees
The Bridge Institute describes a professional development pathway. Submitting an application does not guarantee admission. Completing courses does not guarantee certification, internships or employment, which depend on available programmes, eligibility and employer requirements.

## Content
Course details, schedules and other information may change and are confirmed by the institute.

## Accounts
You are responsible for keeping your password confidential. Accounts may be suspended if these terms are breached.

These terms may be updated by the institute. Contact us with any questions.
